summary: Append accepted continuation curves to an explicit native predecessor figure while retaining source styles and legend behavior.

identity.relation: Accepted kinetic continuation to a composed native figure
identity.definition: Render k*cwp and Re/Im(omega)/wcs1 onto an explicit predecessor figure; pm=-1 retains the source six-label legend composition.
identity.model: Visualization of an already accepted parallel kinetic continuation; no dispersion solve.
identity.boundary: Explicit predecessor figure or fresh axes.
assumptions: cwp and wcs1 are supplied physical normalization scales.
A retained source legend does not prove arbitrary predecessor curve identities.

inputs.name: graph
inputs.description: Accepted continuation with k and omega.

inputs.name: state
inputs.constraints: Caller supplies compatible finite nonzero normalization scales.

inputs.name: predecessor_plot
inputs.description: Explicit predecessor native figure and its scientific provenance.
inputs.shape: NativeResult or mapping containing figure_native bytes, or null
inputs.constraints: figure_native is uint8 and preserved as bytes. None creates fresh axes; caller must establish compatible physical coordinates and curve lineage.

inputs.name: pm
inputs.description: Circular-polarization sign about the fixed positive z basis.
inputs.constraints: Exactly +1 or -1. This is not helicity defined along k and is not swapped when k changes sign.

inputs.name: transport
inputs.description: Optional explicit native executor; None uses the packaged resource closure.
inputs.constraints: Requires a compatible external Octave runtime. No original checkout or network is consulted.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: NativeResult containing native FIG and PNG bytes plus decoded line, axes and legend state; receipt is execution metadata rather than a scientific quantity.
outputs.units: line coordinates follow the plot model; artifact bytes unitless
outputs.shape: state: figure_native/figure_png byte vectors; line_x/line_y vectors; line_offsets/line_axes/line_width; line_markers; axes_limits; legend_labels
outputs.constraints: Line offsets retain the native 1-based convention. All predecessor and appended curves remain represented; the legend is source composition, not independent branch classification.

preconditions: Finite inputs satisfying the declared units and shapes.
supported: Fresh native figures and explicit sequential predecessor composition, pm=+1/-1.
excluded: Inferred predecessor curve physics or an inferred six-branch identity.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError or a missing required mapping key rejects invalid inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency, numerical-library, or native-runtime errors propagate; no silent alternate provider.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result is returned on failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: Unchanged attributed PDRK EM1D plotting suffix, invoked through a derived explicit-state adapter.
provenance.license_status: pending-human-decision: source attribution is retained; redistribution permission and human scientific endorsement are unresolved.

example.description: Render an explicit already accepted vacuum branch.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.plotting import em1d_plot
r = em1d_plot(dict(k=np.array([0.2, 0.3]), omega=np.array([0.2+0j, 0.3+0j])), dict(cwp=1.0, wcs1=1.0))
assert r.state["figure_native"].size > 0
example.expected: A native figure with explicit normalized real and imaginary frequency curves.

scope: Native artifact data, axes, styles and sequential predecessor lineage.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded derived scientific qualification exists. Integrated public signatures, executable examples, and final installed-candidate acceptance require separate verification.
known_limitations: Octave graphics and native figure compatibility are runtime requirements.
Human visual acceptance is separate from typed plot-data/style qualification.
